InvocationRequest.description: The POST /invocations body as this span defines it: a prompt for the agent, an optional run_agent request envelope (the deterministic loop's input, so the runtime and the offline gate consume the SAME ask), and an optional caller session id. AgentCore carries session affinity in the X-Amzn-Bedrock-AgentCore-Runtime-Session-Id header; the body field is the portable mirror for the Lambda and App Runner hosts, which have no such header convention.

InvocationResponse.description: The invocation result: the receipt (receipt.schema.json) is the response body — the runtime adds no envelope of its own, so all three hosts return byte-identical receipts.

time_of_last_update.description: Unix epoch seconds of the last completed invocation.

RunAgentRequest.description: The run_agent(request) envelope from agent.py, verbatim.

description: ONE payload contract, three hosts. Primary: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Runtime — POST /invocations, GET /ping, session affinity via the X-Amzn-Bedrock-AgentCore-Runtime-Session-Id header. Deltas (SPEC section 1): the Lambda host receives the same InvocationRequest as the handler event (session_id from the body field) and returns the same InvocationResponse; the App Runner host is plain HTTP with the same paths and bodies (session header optional, body field authoritative). Nothing host-specific ever enters the payload.
title: Agent runtime contract — one payload, three hosts
